name: loreto-mcp
summary: MCP server for Loreto: your code is your context. Reads a repository for anti-patterns it already reverted, abstractions to reuse, deprecated code and duplication, and installs them as a harness with guard rails for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, Copilot and more; and, with Gitology, asks whether an approach is sound before writing it.
